saw_lines: Bike buyers compare frame, weight and fit before they commit, then buy the one that matches the riding they picture.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a rider decides whether this bike is for them.
Your 30 live ads carry no proof number, so collect one review count or orders shipped and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 21 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so buyers see no reason to trust the bike over the next one. Collect one review count or orders shipped and lead the next batch with it.
16 of your 30 ads are product feed ads with no story, so the feed shows a bike and nothing about why it matters. Add three story ads that give the feed a reason, each with its own opening.
None of your 14 copy ads mentions an offer or discount, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put one reason in line one, such as a first order offer or a bundle.

Your 14 copy ads open with 10 different stories, and the biggest opener leads only 2 ads, so no single story builds up enough repetition to become recognisable. Pick the two strongest stories and build the next batch from them.

ads_1: Rider story ads for the Backroad and Shave, opened by a first order offer
